progress_update.summary: We completed a full kickoff and design discussion for invoker deployment performance metrics (issues #4553 + #4454). Researched the invoker codebase deeply — invocation lifecycle, ResponseStream state machine, gardal token bucket internals, existing metrics patterns. Made all key design decisions through interactive discussion, finalized a metric spec (6 new metrics + 7 existing metrics gaining labels), created an implementation plan with 6 phases, and generated a task breakdown ready for execution. User posted the metric spec as a proposal comment on GitHub issue #4553.
progress_update.goal: Add deployment-level observability to the invoker subsystem so operators can distinguish slow user services from internal Restate bottlenecks. Combined single PR for #4553 (deployment performance metrics) and #4454 (more invoker metrics).
accomplished: Deep codebase research: invoker lifecycle, ResponseStream, gardal token bucket API, metrics patterns
Interactive design discussion resolving all key decisions (label strategy, metric types, scope boundary, throttle approach)
Finalized metric spec: 6 new metrics + label enrichment on 7 existing metrics
Created kickoff document, task_context.md, implementation plan (plan.md), and task breakdown (tasks.md)
User posted metric spec proposal as comment on GitHub issue #4553
progress_update.now: Task breakdown complete and approved. Ready for implementation execution.
